verses.text: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah the son of Cush, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the king of Judah, is this:
"I will utterly consume all things from off the face of the earth," saith the Lord.

"I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the face of the earth," saith the Lord.
"I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests."
"And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham."
"And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor inquired for him, I will cut off."
"The great day of the Lord is near; it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly."
"That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness."
"A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers."
"And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord; and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung."
O ye who dwell in my sanctuary, behold, the people of Canaan have perished, for all who were laden with silver have been cast away; do not be dismayed.

In that time, I shall shine forth upon Jerusalem; upon their altars shall they dwell, and in their hearts shall they say: The Lord shall not do good, nor shall He do evil; I shall be angry with such men.
Their cunning shall become for naught, their houses shall be desolate; they shall build houses, yet they shall not inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards, yet they shall not drink the wine thereof.
The great day of the Lord is near; the day of the Lord is a voice that draws near, it hastens greatly; the mighty shall cry out in bitterness on that day.
That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of devastation and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness.
It is a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high towers.
For sin has been committed against the Lord, and until they depart like the blind, I shall cause men to tremble; their blood shall be as dust, and their flesh shall be as dung.

And in the day of the Lord's anger, their brightness and their gold shall not be able to deliver them; for He shall swiftly consume all who dwell upon the earth, and the whole earth shall be devoured by the fire of His jealousy.

O you people of the land, who have no mercy, take heed! Before the decree goes forth, before the day passes like chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord comes upon you, before the day of the Lord's anger comes upon you, gather yourselves together, yes, gather together.
Seek the Lord, all you who are humble of the earth, who have upheld His justice; seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the Lord's anger.
The land shall be desolate, and the cities shall be a ruin; the inhabitants shall be driven out, and the strongholds shall be laid waste.
Woe to those who dwell by the sea, to the nation of the Philistines! The word of the Lord is against you; I will destroy you so that no one shall dwell there.
And it shall be a dwelling place for jackals and a haunt for ostriches.

The sea shall be a desolation for the house of Judah; there they shall be heard, for their God, the Lord, shall visit them, and He shall restore their fortunes, and in the evening they shall lie down in their houses.
Concerning my people, I have heard what they have spoken; I have heard the taunts against them, the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon.

Therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I am alive! Surely Moab shall be like Sodom, and the children of Ammon like Gomorrah, a place of desolation, a perpetual wasteland; the remnant of my people shall plunder them, and the survivors of my nation shall inherit them.
The Lord of hosts has not been moved against His people, but they have spoken against Him; this shall be their pride.
The Lord shall be terrible against them; He will destroy all the gods of the earth, and all the coastlands of the nations shall worship Him, each one from his place.
And you, O Ethiopians, shall be slain by the sword.
He shall raise His hand against the north, and He shall destroy Assyria; and He shall make Nineveh a desolation, like a dry wilderness.

The beasts of the field and all the creatures of the earth shall gather within her; they shall lie down in her midst, and the owl shall hoot in her windows; their voice shall be heard in her streets; for the cedar shall be laid bare, and devastation shall be upon her foundations.

She is a desolate one, who has settled in her heart: "I am, and besides me there is no other." This city is the rejoicing one; how has she become a desolation, where beasts are gathered! All who pass by her shall shake their hands in derision.
Woe to the city of the oppressor and the defiled, to the city of the cruel!
She has not heard the voice, nor has she accepted correction; she has not trusted in the Lord, nor has she drawn near to her God.
Her leaders within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, they leave nothing for the morning.
Her prophets are reckless and treacherous men; her priests have profaned the sanctuary, they have committed violence against the law.
The Lord is within her; He does no wrong; morning by morning He dispenses His justice, and never fails; but the unjust knows no shame.

I will cut off the nations; their corner towers are desolate; I will make their streets so that no one passes through; their cities are laid waste, so that no one may dwell therein; even one shall not remain.
I too will be afraid; they will accept the correction; I said that nothing shall escape from her eyes, but they rose up in the morning and all their deeds were corrupted.

To gather the nations and to assemble the kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation, all the earth shall be consumed with the fire of My jealousy; for thus says the Lord, "Keep watch over me until the day I rise up," says the Lord.
At that time, I will restore the peoples to a pure language, that they may all call on the name of the Lord and serve Him with one accord.
From the rivers of Ethiopia, those who are scattered shall bring my daughters, and they shall bring my offering to me.
At that time, I will bring forth those who are being oppressed from among you; and you shall not fear in the day of trouble, for I will be with you in all the work of your hands.
And I will gather the remnant of the people from among you; they shall trust in the name of the Lord.

The congregation of Israel shall not commit iniquity, nor shall they speak falsehood; and there shall not be found in their mouths a deceitful tongue; for they shall be fed and shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
O daughter of Zion, sing; O Israel, shout aloud; O daughter of Jerusalem, rejoice and be glad with all your heart.
The Lord has taken away your judgments; He has cast out your enemy. The King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst; you shall see evil no more.
In that day, it shall be said to Jerusalem: Fear not, O Zion; let not your hands be weak.
The Lord your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save; He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you by His love; He will exult over you with loud singing.
I will gather those who are far from the assembly, and I will bring together those who are near to you; they were like a burden upon their shoulders.
At that time, behold, I will deal with all who oppress you; I will save the lame and gather the outcast; and I will change their shame into praise and renown in all the earth.

At that time, I will bring you in, and at that time, I will gather you; for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the Lord.
